# langsmith_run_rule_logs (Data Source)

Reads the execution history of a LangSmith automation (run) rule: `last_applied` is the most recently applied log entry (JSON-encoded, may be null) and `logs` is the list of recorded executions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_run_rule_logs" "example" {
  rule_id = langsmith_run_rule.example.id
}

output "last_applied" {
  value = data.langsmith_run_rule_logs.example.last_applied
}

output "log_count" {
  value = length(data.langsmith_run_rule_logs.example.logs)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_id` (String) The UUID of the run rule whose logs to read.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `last_applied` (String) The most recently applied log entry for the rule, JSON-encoded. Null when the rule has never been applied.
- `logs` (Attributes List) The list of recorded rule executions, most recent first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs))

<a id="nestedatt--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs`

Read-Only:

- `application_time` (String) The time the rule was applied to the run, if available.
- `end_time` (String) The end time of the run.
- `raw_json` (String) The complete log entry as returned by the API, JSON-encoded. Includes the polymorphic per-action outcomes (add_to_annotation_queue, add_to_dataset, evaluators, alerts, webhooks, extend_only).
- `rule_id` (String) The UUID of the rule this log entry belongs to.
- `run_id` (String) The UUID of the run the rule was applied to.
- `run_name` (String) The name of the run, if available.
- `run_session_id` (String) The UUID of the run's session/project, if available.
- `run_type` (String) The type of the run, if available.
- `start_time` (String) The start time of the run.
- `thread_id` (String) The thread ID associated with the run, if available.
